hypothesis: A windup-and-flight interception estimate converts more visible allied reels into double-hook headshots than aiming at the chain midpoint.
baseline: Frozen current local base.bas, including the existing October 26 experimental changes
engine: Canonical Pudge Wars at 32 ticks per second; no engine or observation changes
mechanism: Completed headshots in a fixed moving-reel scenario grid, and headshots per enemy catch in full matches
promotion_gate: At least 25% more scenario headshots, more natural-game headshots per enemy catch, positive paired-map mean kill margin with a positive 95% bootstrap lower bound on fresh confirmation, no VM failures, verified replays, and stock/mixed-team/duel regression checks.
scope: Local policy development only; hosted competitive strength and deployment require separate evidence. Failed variants remain archived; confirmation seeds are not reused for tuning.
reactive_verdict: Rejected: improved some controlled cases but lost both full-match screens. No promotion.

anticipatory_followup.hypothesis: Start a second hook during the final approach of a visible allied hook, aiming at the predicted reel after contact; keep ordinary movement and all baseline fallback skills.
anticipatory_followup.controlled_gate: At least 25% more completed double hooks on the development grid; confirm with real allied casts rather than only injected hook snapshots.
anticipatory_followup.competitive_gate: Freeze before 48 fresh games. Positive paired-map mean kill margin with positive 95% bootstrap lower bound, higher headshots per enemy catch, no VM failures, every replay verified, then stock/mixed/duel guardrails.
anticipatory_followup.note: Selection used the same six development maps on both banks. These are used evidence, not confirmation.
anticipatory_followup.verdict: Rejected: 21/48 wins, mean kill margin -2.0625, 95% paired-map interval [-4.4792, 0.4792], lower headshots per enemy catch. Default unchanged.

guarded_followup.hypothesis: Only anticipate allied catches while free, away from close combat and enemy rot; preserve defensive decisions.
guarded_followup.selection: 7/12 wins on used development maps; mean kill margin +3.25
guarded_followup.gate: Same competitive promotion gate; these maps were not used in prior variants.
guarded_followup.verdict: Rejected: 22/48 wins, mean kill margin -1.3958. Not promoted.

aim_only_followup.hypothesis: Measure hook-head velocity from visible frames, improve only the existing catch-target aim, preserve all casting priorities and movement; fall back to the original midpoint when unobserved.
aim_only_followup.gate: Same competitive gate, no promotion from selection maps alone.
aim_only_followup.selection: 9/12 wins on used development maps; mean kill margin +3.4167.
aim_only_followup.verdict: Not promoted: 26/48 wins, +0.0833 mean kill margin, 95% paired-map interval [-2.0833, 2.0417]. Headshots 498 vs 437; follow-up drill 64/114 vs 60/114, below 25% controlled improvement gate. Combat tests pass.

final_verdict: No candidate cleared the promotion gate. Default, semantic source, coworld copy and hosted champion unchanged. Retain v9 for further double-hook research.

repository_release.authorization: User requested: push new policy, after results and no-promotion recommendation were reported.
repository_release.scope: Repository default and coworld BASIC source only; no hosted champion publication or coworld deployment.
repository_release.gate_status: Original competitive promotion gate failed; selection is explicitly user-directed, not a newly established match advantage.
